single_variable: At a native V1.7 signal, use the asset's trailing 180 consecutive pre-key 12H log returns. If its upper decile is further from the median than the lower decile, allow longs to cancel the 2R target after the first 12H. Reverse for shorts. Otherwise keep the full 2/3 resting 2R target. Unknown or equal asymmetry defaults to persistent orders. The 90/10 quantiles and the existing 90-day eligibility interval are fixed without a grid.
